goal: Implement R-003 range-query API on stores: zero-allocation StoreVisitor range scans for SINGLE and DOUBLE stores.
requirements: Implement inclusive ascending and descending range scans for SINGLE and DOUBLE stores.
Cover empty range, single-key range, full-keyspace range, and reverse scans.
Optional key-prefix filtering must avoid Consumer boxing and visitor hot-path allocation.
constraints: Alloc gate must stay green on the visitor hot path.
Do not introduce sorted-by-value queries, composite keys, or secondary indexes.
acceptance_criteria: Range tests cover empty range, single-key range, full-keyspace, and reverse scan.
SINGLE and DOUBLE store variants are both covered.
Feature-specific range tests pass and qa/smoke.sh passes the benchmark-smoke allocation gate.
